ModMetaData.name: mulld Priorities
ModMetaData.author: mulld
ModMetaData.description:
See what your colony needs. Give your pawns useful work. Review before applying.
mulld Priorities brings colony needs and work rules into the Work tab. Track food, care and harvest pressure; choose Balanced, Clean, Harvest or Haul; and preview changes directly in the grid. Includes custom presets, backups, locks, exclusions and undo.
Manual approval by default. Optional daily automation and diagnostics are off by default.
Requires RimWorld 1.7 and Harmony. Standard Off / 1–4 priorities.
